name: 🫓 Greek Chicken Naan & Tzatziki
what: Lemon-garlic chicken on warm naan with a cool cucumber sauce (tzatziki).

core.name: Nounos plain Greek yogurt (for the sauce)
core.out: our other version: sour cream + a little cream cheese

core.name: Mini cucumbers
core.out: skip them in the sauce, still good

extras: garlic, fresh dill or herbs, cherry tomatoes, red onion, oregano

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Toss the chicken with oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano and salt.
Sauce: grate 2 cucumbers, squeeze out the water in a towel, stir into the yogurt with garlic, dill, lemon and salt.
Cook the chicken in a hot skillet until done. Rest 5 minutes, then slice.
Warm the naan in the skillet or oven.
Build: naan, sauce, chicken, tomatoes, cucumbers.

key: Squeeze the grated cucumber hard in a towel. Wet cucumber makes watery sauce.
done: Chicken is 165°F inside, white all the way through.
plan_b: No naan? Chicken and sauce over rice with sliced cucumbers.
